newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland grants licence for A-2 motorway.
newsitem.headline: Poland grants licence for A-2 motorway.

text.p: Polish transport minister on Wednesday granted the first licence to build and operate a motorway in the country's 2,500-kilometres motorway scheme to a consortium Autostrada Wielkopolska SA, PAP news agency said.
The consortium will build and operate 364-km A-2 toll motorway, which will link the central city of Lodz and Swiecko on the German border.
Autostrada Wielkopolska SA's main shareholders are Polish Kulczyk Holding which has 31.4 percent in the consortium and Elektrim which has 28.4 percent. @

Polish WBK, consortium Autostrady SA and Warta, each have 9.7-percent stakes, Polish metals trader Impexmetal and aluminium plant Huta Aluminium Konin have five percent each and the remaining shareholders have about one percent.
Poland plans to build 2,500 kilometres of toll expressways over the next 15 years. The total cost of the construction is estimated at $8 billion.
